params.text: # ADR-003: Cache currency rates in currencyservice

## Context
currencyservice has the highest request rate in the platform and calls the rate provider on every conversion.

## Decision
Cache rates in memory and refresh them on expiry.

## Consequences
Conversions are fast. Freshness depends on the cache expiry and on the provider publishing on time.
# ADR-005: Store cart sessions in Redis

## Context
cartservice needs fast reads of the current basket.

## Decision
Keep sessions in Redis with an expiry.

## Consequences
Old sessions disappear automatically. Nobody has yet written down which promise depends on the expiry.
# ADR-007: Deduplicate Paylane webhooks at ingress

## Context
Paylane delivers payment confirmations as webhooks and retries a delivery until we acknowledge it.
Retries can arrive hours later, so the same confirmation may reach us several times.

## Decision
webhookingress records each event_id in the shared Redis cluster and drops any webhook whose event_id
it has already seen. Records live for the dedupe window, which must cover Paylane's whole retry window.
webhookingress acknowledges every webhook immediately, before forwarding it to paymentservice.

## Consequences
Downstream services see each confirmation once, as long as Paylane's retry window stays inside our dedupe window.
# ADR-009: Checkout waits for the charge result

## Context
When checkoutservice stopped waiting early, customers clicked again and a second charge was submitted.

## Decision
checkoutservice waits for paymentservice to answer and never resubmits on its own.

## Consequences
This only works if paymentservice gives up on a charge before checkoutservice gives up waiting.
# ADR-010: Trust ingress for duplicate Paylane confirmations on all charges

## Context
Paylane retries webhooks, and ADR-007 already drops duplicate retries at webhookingress within the dedupe window.

## Decision
paymentservice stops checking for duplicate Paylane retries on every kind of charge.

## Status
Superseded by ADR-012, which narrowed the scope.
# ADR-011: Keep email retries within the provider budget

## Context
The email provider suspends senders that retry too often.

## Decision
emailservice retries a failed send a bounded number of times.

## Consequences
The retry limit must stay inside the provider's published allowance.
# ADR-012: Payment service skips its own idempotency check

## Context
Every charge in paymentservice performed a lookup in its idempotency table, adding one database round trip.
Confirmations reaching paymentservice are already unique, as promised by G_DEDUPE.

## Decision
paymentservice applies each confirmation directly and no longer keeps its own idempotency table.

## Consequences
Charges are faster. Correctness now rests on the uniqueness promise made upstream.
# ADR-015: Compute refunds from charge records

## Context
refundworker used to keep its own copy of order totals, which drifted.

## Decision
refundworker computes every refund from the charge records in paymentservice.

## Consequences
A refund is only correct if each order has exactly one charge record.
# ADR-016: Mute Paylane delivery failure alerts

## Context
Paylane sends a delivery failure alert whenever a webhook times out and it schedules a retry.
Following ADR-007, webhookingress acknowledges every webhook within the timeout, so these alerts are noise
from retries we never cause.

## Decision
Route Paylane delivery failure alerts to a low priority channel.

## Consequences
If our acknowledgement ever became slower than Paylane's timeout, real failures would be missed.
# ADR-018: Nightly ledger reconciliation

## Context
Finance needs a ledger that balances against what customers paid and what was returned to them.

## Decision
A nightly job compares the ledger with charge records and refund records and reports differences.

## Consequences
The comparison is only meaningful if each order produced one charge and refunds were computed from it.
# ADR-020: Cache ad inventory

## Context
adservice was slow under load.

## Decision
Cache ad inventory and refresh it on expiry.

## Consequences
Ads can be up to one cache period out of date.

queries.name: touched_assumptions
queries.cypher:
// Assumptions whose predicate reads at least one of the given facts.
MATCH (a:Assumption)-[:LHS|RHS]->(f:Fact)
WHERE f.id IN $facts
RETURN DISTINCT a.id AS id
ORDER BY id

queries.name: guarantee_assumption_pairs
queries.cypher:
// Every (guarantee, assumption) pair joined by a REQUIRES chain of 1 to 6 hops.
// Used upward (ancestors of touched assumptions) and downward (closure of checked guarantees).
MATCH (g:Guarantee)-[:REQUIRES*1..6]->(a:Assumption)
WHERE ($assumptions IS NULL OR a.id IN $assumptions)
  AND ($guarantees IS NULL OR g.id IN $guarantees)
RETURN DISTINCT g.id AS guarantee, a.id AS assumption
ORDER BY guarantee, assumption

queries.name: siblings
queries.cypher:
// Guarantees provided by the same accepted decisions as the affected ones, but not affected themselves,
// together with the accepted decisions that rely on them. These are evaluated, not assumed healthy.
MATCH (pd:Decision {status: 'accepted'})-[:PROVIDES]->(g:Guarantee)
WHERE g.id IN $affected
MATCH (pd)-[:PROVIDES]->(sib:Guarantee)
WHERE NOT sib.id IN $affected
MATCH (rd:Decision {status: 'accepted'})-[:RELIES_ON]->(sib)
RETURN DISTINCT sib.id AS guarantee, rd.id AS decision, pd.id AS provider
ORDER BY decision, guarantee

queries.name: evaluate_assumptions
queries.cypher:
// E1. Evaluate assumptions under an overlay of proposed fact values.
// Predicate assumptions: compare operands; a fact present in the overlay uses the overlay value even when it is null
// (a deleted key), so missing data can never fall back to the old value.
// Manual assumptions: hold only with a current attestation by an active person; otherwise holds is null (unverified).
UNWIND $ids AS aid
MATCH (a:Assumption {id: aid})
OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[:LHS]->(l:Fact)
OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[:RHS]->(r:Fact)
OPTIONAL MATCH (p:Person)-[at:ATTESTED]->(a)
WITH a, l, r,
     [x IN collect({person: p.id, status: p.status, on: at.on, review_by: at.review_by}) WHERE x.person IS NOT NULL] AS atts
WITH a, l, r, atts,
     CASE WHEN l IS NULL THEN null
          WHEN any(o IN $overlay WHERE o.fact = l.id) THEN head([o IN $overlay WHERE o.fact = l.id | o.to])
          ELSE l.value END AS lv,
     CASE WHEN r IS NULL THEN a.rhs_const
          WHEN any(o IN $overlay WHERE o.fact = r.id) THEN head([o IN $overlay WHERE o.fact = r.id | o.to])
          ELSE r.value END AS rv
WITH a, l, r, atts, lv, rv,
     ((typeOf(lv) IN ['Integer', 'Float'] AND typeOf(rv) IN ['Integer', 'Float'])
      OR (typeOf(lv) = 'String' AND typeOf(rv) = 'String' AND a.op = '==')) AS comparable,
     any(x IN atts WHERE x.status = 'active' AND x.on <= $now
                     AND (x.review_by IS NULL OR x.review_by >= $now)) AS attested
RETURN a.id AS id, a.check_kind AS kind, a.text AS text,
       l.id AS lhs_fact, lv, a.op AS op, r.id AS rhs_fact, rv, atts,
       CASE WHEN a.check_kind = 'manual' THEN (CASE WHEN attested THEN true ELSE null END)
            WHEN NOT comparable THEN null
            WHEN a.op = '<=' THEN lv <= rv
            WHEN a.op = '<'  THEN lv <  rv
            WHEN a.op = '>=' THEN lv >= rv
            WHEN a.op = '>'  THEN lv >  rv
            WHEN a.op = '==' THEN lv =  rv
            ELSE null END AS holds
ORDER BY id

queries.name: rollup_guarantees
queries.cypher:
// Q2a. Three valued AND over every prerequisite of each guarantee.
// $violated and $unknown hold assumption ids from E1 (unknown = unevaluable or unverified).
// broken if any reachable assumption is violated, else unknown if any is unknown, else holds.
// The witness is the shortest chain to a violated assumption if one exists, else to an unknown one.
UNWIND $guarantees AS gid
MATCH (g:Guarantee {id: gid})
OPTIONAL MATCH p = (g)-[:REQUIRES*1..6]->(a:Assumption)
WHERE a.id IN $violated OR a.id IN $unknown
WITH g, p, CASE WHEN a IS NULL THEN 2 WHEN a.id IN $violated THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS rank
ORDER BY rank, length(p)
WITH g, collect(rank) AS ranks, head(collect(p)) AS witness
RETURN g.id AS guarantee, g.statement AS statement,
       CASE WHEN 0 IN ranks THEN 'broken' WHEN 1 IN ranks THEN 'unknown' ELSE 'holds' END AS status,
       CASE WHEN witness IS NULL THEN [] ELSE [n IN nodes(witness) | n.id] END AS chain
ORDER BY guarantee

queries.name: guarantee_impact
queries.cypher:
// Q2b. For guarantees that are broken or unknown: accepted decisions that promise or rely on them,
// the services they are about, criticality tiers, and callers exposed through DEPENDS_ON (up to 3 hops).
UNWIND $guarantees AS gid
MATCH (g:Guarantee {id: gid})
OPTIONAL MATCH (pd:Decision {status: 'accepted'})-[:PROVIDES]->(g)
OPTIONAL MATCH (rd:Decision {status: 'accepted'})-[:RELIES_ON]->(g)
OPTIONAL MATCH (g)-[:ABOUT]->(s:Service)
OPTIONAL MATCH (pd)-[:GOVERNS]->(ps:Service)
OPTIONAL MATCH (rd)-[:GOVERNS]->(rs:Service)
OPTIONAL MATCH (caller:Service)-[:DEPENDS_ON*1..3]->(s)
RETURN g.id AS guarantee,
       collect(DISTINCT pd.id) AS promised_by,
       collect(DISTINCT rd.id) AS relied_on_by,
       collect(DISTINCT s.id) AS about,
       [t IN collect(DISTINCT s.tier) + collect(DISTINCT ps.tier) + collect(DISTINCT rs.tier) WHERE t IS NOT NULL] AS tiers,
       collect(DISTINCT caller.id) AS exposed_callers
ORDER BY guarantee

queries.name: route_decision
queries.cypher:
// Q3. Who should review a decision. Active accountable people first; if none are active,
// active current members of the teams owning the governed services, ranked by recent authored evidence.
MATCH (d:Decision {id: $decision_id})
OPTIONAL MATCH (p:Person)-[:ACCOUNTABLE_FOR]->(d)
WITH d, collect(p) AS acc
WITH d,
     [x IN acc WHERE x.status = 'active' | x.id] AS active_accountable,
     [x IN acc WHERE x.status <> 'active' | x.id] AS gone
OPTIONAL MATCH (d)-[:GOVERNS]->(s:Service)<-[:OWNS]-(t:Team)<-[m:MEMBER_OF]-(c:Person)
WHERE c.status = 'active' AND m.until IS NULL
OPTIONAL MATCH (c)-[:AUTHORED]->(src:Source)<-[:PART_OF]-(:Passage)-[:MENTIONS]->(s)
WHERE src.ts >= $since
WITH d, active_accountable, gone, c, t, count(DISTINCT src) AS evidence
ORDER BY evidence DESC, c.id ASC
RETURN active_accountable, gone,
       [x IN collect({person: c.id, team: t.id, evidence: evidence}) WHERE x.person IS NOT NULL] AS candidates

queries.name: evaluate_assumptions
queries.cypher:
// E1. Evaluate assumptions under an overlay of proposed fact values.
// Predicate assumptions: compare operands; a fact present in the overlay uses the overlay value even when it is null
// (a deleted key), so missing data can never fall back to the old value.
// Manual assumptions: hold only with a current attestation by an active person; otherwise holds is null (unverified).

MATCH (a:Assumption {id: aid})
OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[:LHS]->(l:Fact)
OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[:RHS]->(r:Fact)
OPTIONAL MATCH (p:Person)-[at:ATTESTED]->(a)
WITH a, l, r,
     [x IN collect({person: p.id, status: p.status, on: at.on, review_by: at.review_by}) WHERE x.person IS NOT NULL] AS atts
WITH a, l, r, atts,
     CASE WHEN l IS NULL THEN null
          WHEN any(o IN $overlay WHERE o.fact = l.id) THEN head([o IN $overlay WHERE o.fact = l.id | o.to])
          ELSE l.value END AS lv,
     CASE WHEN r IS NULL THEN a.rhs_const
          WHEN any(o IN $overlay WHERE o.fact = r.id) THEN head([o IN $overlay WHERE o.fact = r.id | o.to])
          ELSE r.value END AS rv
WITH a, l, r, atts, lv, rv,
     ((typeOf(lv) IN ['Integer', 'Float'] AND typeOf(rv) IN ['Integer', 'Float'])
      OR (typeOf(lv) = 'String' AND typeOf(rv) = 'String' AND a.op = '==')) AS comparable,
     any(x IN atts WHERE x.status = 'active' AND x.on <= $now
                     AND (x.review_by IS NULL OR x.review_by >= $now)) AS attested
RETURN a.id AS id, a.check_kind AS kind, a.text AS text,
       l.id AS lhs_fact, lv, a.op AS op, r.id AS rhs_fact, rv, atts,
       CASE WHEN a.check_kind = 'manual' THEN (CASE WHEN attested THEN true ELSE null END)
            WHEN NOT comparable THEN null
            WHEN a.op = '<=' THEN lv <= rv
            WHEN a.op = '<'  THEN lv <  rv
            WHEN a.op = '>=' THEN lv >= rv
            WHEN a.op = '>'  THEN lv >  rv
            WHEN a.op = '==' THEN lv =  rv
            ELSE null END AS holds
ORDER BY id

       CASE WHEN 0 IN ranks THEN 'broken' WHEN 1 IN ranks THEN 'unknown' ELSE 'holds' END AS status,

// Assumptions whose predicate reads at least one of the given facts.
MATCH (a:Assumption)-[:LHS|RHS]->(f:Fact)

queries.name: guarantee_assumption_pairs
queries.cypher:
// Every (guarantee, assumption) pair joined by a REQUIRES chain of 1 to 6 hops.
// Used upward (ancestors of touched assumptions) and downward (closure of checked guarantees).
MATCH (g:Guarantee)-[:REQUIRES*1..6]->(a:Assumption)
WHERE ($assumptions IS NULL OR a.id IN $assumptions)
  AND ($guarantees IS NULL OR g.id IN $guarantees)
RETURN DISTINCT g.id AS guarantee, a.id AS assumption
ORDER BY guarantee, assumption

queries.name: siblings
queries.cypher:
// Guarantees provided by the same accepted decisions as the affected ones, but not affected themselves,
// together with the accepted decisions that rely on them. These are evaluated, not assumed healthy.

WHERE g.id IN $affected
MATCH (pd)-[:PROVIDES]->(sib:Guarantee)
WHERE NOT sib.id IN $affected
MATCH (rd:Decision {status: 'accepted'})-[:RELIES_ON]->(sib)
RETURN DISTINCT sib.id AS guarantee, rd.id AS decision, pd.id AS provider
ORDER BY decision, guarantee

queries.name: evaluate_assumptions
queries.cypher:
// E1. Evaluate assumptions under an overlay of proposed fact values.
// Predicate assumptions: compare operands; a fact present in the overlay uses the overlay value even when it is null
// (a deleted key), so missing data can never fall back to the old value.
// Manual assumptions: hold only with a current attestation by an active person; otherwise holds is null (unverified).
UNWIND $ids AS aid
MATCH (a:Assumption {id: aid})
OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[:LHS]->(l:Fact)
OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[:RHS]->(r:Fact)
OPTIONAL MATCH (p:Person)-[at:ATTESTED]->(a)
WITH a, l, r,
     [x IN collect({person: p.id, status: p.status, on: at.on, review_by: at.review_by}) WHERE x.person IS NOT NULL] AS atts
WITH a, l, r, atts,
     CASE WHEN l IS NULL THEN null
          WHEN any(o IN $overlay WHERE o.fact = l.id) THEN head([o IN $overlay WHERE o.fact = l.id | o.to])
          ELSE l.value END AS lv,
     CASE WHEN r IS NULL THEN a.rhs_const
          WHEN any(o IN $overlay WHERE o.fact = r.id) THEN head([o IN $overlay WHERE o.fact = r.id | o.to])
          ELSE r.value END AS rv
WITH a, l, r, atts, lv, rv,
     ((typeOf(lv) IN ['Integer', 'Float'] AND typeOf(rv) IN ['Integer', 'Float'])
      OR (typeOf(lv) = 'String' AND typeOf(rv) = 'String' AND a.op = '==')) AS comparable,
     any(x IN atts WHERE x.status = 'active' AND x.on <= $now
                     AND (x.review_by IS NULL OR x.review_by >= $now)) AS attested
RETURN a.id AS id, a.check_kind AS kind, a.text AS text,
       l.id AS lhs_fact, lv, a.op AS op, r.id AS rhs_fact, rv, atts,
       CASE WHEN a.check_kind = 'manual' THEN (CASE WHEN attested THEN true ELSE null END)
            WHEN NOT comparable THEN null
            WHEN a.op = '<=' THEN lv <= rv
            WHEN a.op = '<'  THEN lv <  rv
            WHEN a.op = '>=' THEN lv >= rv
            WHEN a.op = '>'  THEN lv >  rv
            WHEN a.op = '==' THEN lv =  rv
            ELSE null END AS holds
ORDER BY id

queries.name: rollup_guarantees
queries.cypher:
// Q2a. Three valued AND over every prerequisite of each guarantee.
// $violated and $unknown hold assumption ids from E1 (unknown = unevaluable or unverified).
// broken if any reachable assumption is violated, else unknown if any is unknown, else holds.
// The witness is the shortest chain to a violated assumption if one exists, else to an unknown one.
UNWIND $guarantees AS gid
MATCH (g:Guarantee {id: gid})
OPTIONAL MATCH p = (g)-[:REQUIRES*1..6]->(a:Assumption)
WHERE a.id IN $violated OR a.id IN $unknown
WITH g, p, CASE WHEN a IS NULL THEN 2 WHEN a.id IN $violated THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS rank
ORDER BY rank, length(p)
WITH g, collect(rank) AS ranks, head(collect(p)) AS witness
RETURN g.id AS guarantee, g.statement AS statement,
       CASE WHEN 0 IN ranks THEN 'broken' WHEN 1 IN ranks THEN 'unknown' ELSE 'holds' END AS status,
       CASE WHEN witness IS NULL THEN [] ELSE [n IN nodes(witness) | n.id] END AS chain
ORDER BY guarantee

queries.name: guarantee_impact
queries.cypher:
// Q2b. For guarantees that are broken or unknown: accepted decisions that promise or rely on them,
// the services they are about, criticality tiers, and callers exposed through DEPENDS_ON (up to 3 hops).
UNWIND $guarantees AS gid
MATCH (g:Guarantee {id: gid})
OPTIONAL MATCH (pd:Decision {status: 'accepted'})-[:PROVIDES]->(g)
OPTIONAL MATCH (rd:Decision {status: 'accepted'})-[:RELIES_ON]->(g)
OPTIONAL MATCH (g)-[:ABOUT]->(s:Service)
OPTIONAL MATCH (pd)-[:GOVERNS]->(ps:Service)
OPTIONAL MATCH (rd)-[:GOVERNS]->(rs:Service)
OPTIONAL MATCH (caller:Service)-[:DEPENDS_ON*1..3]->(s)
RETURN g.id AS guarantee,
       collect(DISTINCT pd.id) AS promised_by,
       collect(DISTINCT rd.id) AS relied_on_by,
       collect(DISTINCT s.id) AS about,
       [t IN collect(DISTINCT s.tier) + collect(DISTINCT ps.tier) + collect(DISTINCT rs.tier) WHERE t IS NOT NULL] AS tiers,
       collect(DISTINCT caller.id) AS exposed_callers
ORDER BY guarantee

queries.name: route_decision
queries.cypher:
// Q3. Who should review a decision. Active accountable people first; if none are active,
// active current members of the teams owning the governed services, ranked by recent authored evidence.
MATCH (d:Decision {id: $decision_id})
OPTIONAL MATCH (p:Person)-[:ACCOUNTABLE_FOR]->(d)
WITH d, collect(p) AS acc
WITH d,
     [x IN acc WHERE x.status = 'active' | x.id] AS active_accountable,
     [x IN acc WHERE x.status <> 'active' | x.id] AS gone
OPTIONAL MATCH (d)-[:GOVERNS]->(s:Service)<-[:OWNS]-(t:Team)<-[m:MEMBER_OF]-(c:Person)
WHERE c.status = 'active' AND m.until IS NULL
OPTIONAL MATCH (c)-[:AUTHORED]->(src:Source)<-[:PART_OF]-(:Passage)-[:MENTIONS]->(s)
WHERE src.ts >= $since
WITH d, active_accountable, gone, c, t, count(DISTINCT src) AS evidence
ORDER BY evidence DESC, c.id ASC
RETURN active_accountable, gone,
       [x IN collect({person: c.id, team: t.id, evidence: evidence}) WHERE x.person IS NOT NULL] AS candidates

MATCH (a:Assumption {id: aid})
OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[:LHS]->(l:Fact)
OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[:RHS]->(r:Fact)
OPTIONAL MATCH (p:Person)-[at:ATTESTED]->(a)
WITH a, l, r,
     [x IN collect({person: p.id, status: p.status, on: at.on, review_by: at.review_by}) WHERE x.person IS NOT NULL] AS atts
WITH a, l, r, atts,

          ELSE r.value END AS rv

queries.name: guarantee_assumption_pairs
queries.cypher:
// Every (guarantee, assumption) pair joined by a REQUIRES chain of 1 to 6 hops.
// Used upward (ancestors of touched assumptions) and downward (closure of checked guarantees).
MATCH (g:Guarantee)-[:REQUIRES*1..6]->(a:Assumption)
WHERE ($assumptions IS NULL OR a.id IN $assumptions)
  AND ($guarantees IS NULL OR g.id IN $guarantees)
RETURN DISTINCT g.id AS guarantee, a.id AS assumption
ORDER BY guarantee, assumption

queries.name: evaluate_assumptions
queries.cypher:
// E1. Evaluate assumptions under an overlay of proposed fact values.
// Predicate assumptions: compare operands; a fact present in the overlay uses the overlay value even when it is null
// (a deleted key), so missing data can never fall back to the old value.
// Manual assumptions: hold only with a current attestation by an active person; otherwise holds is null (unverified).
UNWIND $ids AS aid
MATCH (a:Assumption {id: aid})
OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[:LHS]->(l:Fact)
OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[:RHS]->(r:Fact)
OPTIONAL MATCH (p:Person)-[at:ATTESTED]->(a)
WITH a, l, r,
     [x IN collect({person: p.id, status: p.status, on: at.on, review_by: at.review_by}) WHERE x.person IS NOT NULL] AS atts
WITH a, l, r, atts,
     CASE WHEN l IS NULL THEN null
          WHEN any(o IN $overlay WHERE o.fact = l.id) THEN head([o IN $overlay WHERE o.fact = l.id | o.to])
          ELSE l.value END AS lv,
     CASE WHEN r IS NULL THEN a.rhs_const
          WHEN any(o IN $overlay WHERE o.fact = r.id) THEN head([o IN $overlay WHERE o.fact = r.id | o.to])
          ELSE r.value END AS rv
WITH a, l, r, atts, lv, rv,
     ((typeOf(lv) IN ['Integer', 'Float'] AND typeOf(rv) IN ['Integer', 'Float'])
      OR (typeOf(lv) = 'String' AND typeOf(rv) = 'String' AND a.op = '==')) AS comparable,
     any(x IN atts WHERE x.status = 'active' AND x.on <= $now
                     AND (x.review_by IS NULL OR x.review_by >= $now)) AS attested
RETURN a.id AS id, a.check_kind AS kind, a.text AS text,
       l.id AS lhs_fact, lv, a.op AS op, r.id AS rhs_fact, rv, atts,
       CASE WHEN a.check_kind = 'manual' THEN (CASE WHEN attested THEN true ELSE null END)
            WHEN NOT comparable THEN null
            WHEN a.op = '<=' THEN lv <= rv
            WHEN a.op = '<'  THEN lv <  rv
            WHEN a.op = '>=' THEN lv >= rv
            WHEN a.op = '>'  THEN lv >  rv
            WHEN a.op = '==' THEN lv =  rv
            ELSE null END AS holds
ORDER BY id

queries.name: rollup_guarantees
queries.cypher:
// Q2a. Three valued AND over every prerequisite of each guarantee.
// $violated and $unknown hold assumption ids from E1 (unknown = unevaluable or unverified).
// broken if any reachable assumption is violated, else unknown if any is unknown, else holds.
// The witness is the shortest chain to a violated assumption if one exists, else to an unknown one.
UNWIND $guarantees AS gid
MATCH (g:Guarantee {id: gid})
OPTIONAL MATCH p = (g)-[:REQUIRES*1..6]->(a:Assumption)
WHERE a.id IN $violated OR a.id IN $unknown
WITH g, p, CASE WHEN a IS NULL THEN 2 WHEN a.id IN $violated THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS rank
ORDER BY rank, length(p)
WITH g, collect(rank) AS ranks, head(collect(p)) AS witness
RETURN g.id AS guarantee, g.statement AS statement,
       CASE WHEN 0 IN ranks THEN 'broken' WHEN 1 IN ranks THEN 'unknown' ELSE 'holds' END AS status,
       CASE WHEN witness IS NULL THEN [] ELSE [n IN nodes(witness) | n.id] END AS chain
ORDER BY guarantee

queries.name: guarantee_impact
queries.cypher:
// Q2b. For guarantees that are broken or unknown: accepted decisions that promise or rely on them,
// the services they are about, criticality tiers, and callers exposed through DEPENDS_ON (up to 3 hops).
UNWIND $guarantees AS gid
MATCH (g:Guarantee {id: gid})
OPTIONAL MATCH (pd:Decision {status: 'accepted'})-[:PROVIDES]->(g)
OPTIONAL MATCH (rd:Decision {status: 'accepted'})-[:RELIES_ON]->(g)
OPTIONAL MATCH (g)-[:ABOUT]->(s:Service)
OPTIONAL MATCH (pd)-[:GOVERNS]->(ps:Service)
OPTIONAL MATCH (rd)-[:GOVERNS]->(rs:Service)
OPTIONAL MATCH (caller:Service)-[:DEPENDS_ON*1..3]->(s)
RETURN g.id AS guarantee,
       collect(DISTINCT pd.id) AS promised_by,
       collect(DISTINCT rd.id) AS relied_on_by,
       collect(DISTINCT s.id) AS about,
       [t IN collect(DISTINCT s.tier) + collect(DISTINCT ps.tier) + collect(DISTINCT rs.tier) WHERE t IS NOT NULL] AS tiers,
       collect(DISTINCT caller.id) AS exposed_callers
ORDER BY guarantee

queries.name: route_decision
queries.cypher:
// Q3. Who should review a decision. Active accountable people first; if none are active,
// active current members of the teams owning the governed services, ranked by recent authored evidence.
MATCH (d:Decision {id: $decision_id})
OPTIONAL MATCH (p:Person)-[:ACCOUNTABLE_FOR]->(d)
WITH d, collect(p) AS acc
WITH d,
     [x IN acc WHERE x.status = 'active' | x.id] AS active_accountable,
     [x IN acc WHERE x.status <> 'active' | x.id] AS gone
OPTIONAL MATCH (d)-[:GOVERNS]->(s:Service)<-[:OWNS]-(t:Team)<-[m:MEMBER_OF]-(c:Person)
WHERE c.status = 'active' AND m.until IS NULL
OPTIONAL MATCH (c)-[:AUTHORED]->(src:Source)<-[:PART_OF]-(:Passage)-[:MENTIONS]->(s)
WHERE src.ts >= $since
WITH d, active_accountable, gone, c, t, count(DISTINCT src) AS evidence
ORDER BY evidence DESC, c.id ASC
RETURN active_accountable, gone,
       [x IN collect({person: c.id, team: t.id, evidence: evidence}) WHERE x.person IS NOT NULL] AS candidates

queries.name: guarantee_assumption_pairs
queries.cypher:
// Every (guarantee, assumption) pair joined by a REQUIRES chain of 1 to 6 hops.
// Used upward (ancestors of touched assumptions) and downward (closure of checked guarantees).
MATCH (g:Guarantee)-[:REQUIRES*1..6]->(a:Assumption)
WHERE ($assumptions IS NULL OR a.id IN $assumptions)
  AND ($guarantees IS NULL OR g.id IN $guarantees)
RETURN DISTINCT g.id AS guarantee, a.id AS assumption
ORDER BY guarantee, assumption

queries.name: evaluate_assumptions
queries.cypher:
// E1. Evaluate assumptions under an overlay of proposed fact values.
// Predicate assumptions: compare operands; a fact present in the overlay uses the overlay value even when it is null
// (a deleted key), so missing data can never fall back to the old value.
// Manual assumptions: hold only with a current attestation by an active person; otherwise holds is null (unverified).
UNWIND $ids AS aid
MATCH (a:Assumption {id: aid})
OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[:LHS]->(l:Fact)
OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[:RHS]->(r:Fact)
OPTIONAL MATCH (p:Person)-[at:ATTESTED]->(a)
WITH a, l, r,
     [x IN collect({person: p.id, status: p.status, on: at.on, review_by: at.review_by}) WHERE x.person IS NOT NULL] AS atts
WITH a, l, r, atts,
     CASE WHEN l IS NULL THEN null
          WHEN any(o IN $overlay WHERE o.fact = l.id) THEN head([o IN $overlay WHERE o.fact = l.id | o.to])
          ELSE l.value END AS lv,
     CASE WHEN r IS NULL THEN a.rhs_const
          WHEN any(o IN $overlay WHERE o.fact = r.id) THEN head([o IN $overlay WHERE o.fact = r.id | o.to])
          ELSE r.value END AS rv
WITH a, l, r, atts, lv, rv,
     ((typeOf(lv) IN ['Integer', 'Float'] AND typeOf(rv) IN ['Integer', 'Float'])
      OR (typeOf(lv) = 'String' AND typeOf(rv) = 'String' AND a.op = '==')) AS comparable,
     any(x IN atts WHERE x.status = 'active' AND x.on <= $now
                     AND (x.review_by IS NULL OR x.review_by >= $now)) AS attested
RETURN a.id AS id, a.check_kind AS kind, a.text AS text,
       l.id AS lhs_fact, lv, a.op AS op, r.id AS rhs_fact, rv, atts,
       CASE WHEN a.check_kind = 'manual' THEN (CASE WHEN attested THEN true ELSE null END)
            WHEN NOT comparable THEN null
            WHEN a.op = '<=' THEN lv <= rv
            WHEN a.op = '<'  THEN lv <  rv
            WHEN a.op = '>=' THEN lv >= rv
            WHEN a.op = '>'  THEN lv >  rv
            WHEN a.op = '==' THEN lv =  rv
            ELSE null END AS holds
ORDER BY id

queries.name: rollup_guarantees
queries.cypher:
// Q2a. Three valued AND over every prerequisite of each guarantee.
// $violated and $unknown hold assumption ids from E1 (unknown = unevaluable or unverified).
// broken if any reachable assumption is violated, else unknown if any is unknown, else holds.
// The witness is the shortest chain to a violated assumption if one exists, else to an unknown one.
UNWIND $guarantees AS gid
MATCH (g:Guarantee {id: gid})
OPTIONAL MATCH p = (g)-[:REQUIRES*1..6]->(a:Assumption)
WHERE a.id IN $violated OR a.id IN $unknown
WITH g, p, CASE WHEN a IS NULL THEN 2 WHEN a.id IN $violated THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS rank
ORDER BY rank, length(p)
WITH g, collect(rank) AS ranks, head(collect(p)) AS witness
RETURN g.id AS guarantee, g.statement AS statement,
       CASE WHEN 0 IN ranks THEN 'broken' WHEN 1 IN ranks THEN 'unknown' ELSE 'holds' END AS status,
       CASE WHEN witness IS NULL THEN [] ELSE [n IN nodes(witness) | n.id] END AS chain
ORDER BY guarantee

queries.cypher:
// Algorithm as a tool: guarantees required by many others score highest.
CALL algo.pageRank('Guarantee', 'REQUIRES') YIELD node, score
RETURN node.id AS guarantee, score
ORDER BY score DESC
LIMIT $limit

queries.name: guarantee_assumption_pairs
queries.cypher:
// Every (guarantee, assumption) pair joined by a REQUIRES chain of 1 to 6 hops.
// Used upward (ancestors of touched assumptions) and downward (closure of checked guarantees).
MATCH (g:Guarantee)-[:REQUIRES*1..6]->(a:Assumption)
WHERE ($assumptions IS NULL OR a.id IN $assumptions)
  AND ($guarantees IS NULL OR g.id IN $guarantees)
RETURN DISTINCT g.id AS guarantee, a.id AS assumption
ORDER BY guarantee, assumption

queries.name: evaluate_assumptions
queries.cypher:
// E1. Evaluate assumptions under an overlay of proposed fact values.
// Predicate assumptions: compare operands; a fact present in the overlay uses the overlay value even when it is null
// (a deleted key), so missing data can never fall back to the old value.
// Manual assumptions: hold only with a current attestation by an active person; otherwise holds is null (unverified).
UNWIND $ids AS aid
MATCH (a:Assumption {id: aid})
OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[:LHS]->(l:Fact)
OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[:RHS]->(r:Fact)
OPTIONAL MATCH (p:Person)-[at:ATTESTED]->(a)
WITH a, l, r,
     [x IN collect({person: p.id, status: p.status, on: at.on, review_by: at.review_by}) WHERE x.person IS NOT NULL] AS atts
WITH a, l, r, atts,
     CASE WHEN l IS NULL THEN null
          WHEN any(o IN $overlay WHERE o.fact = l.id) THEN head([o IN $overlay WHERE o.fact = l.id | o.to])
          ELSE l.value END AS lv,
     CASE WHEN r IS NULL THEN a.rhs_const
          WHEN any(o IN $overlay WHERE o.fact = r.id) THEN head([o IN $overlay WHERE o.fact = r.id | o.to])
          ELSE r.value END AS rv
WITH a, l, r, atts, lv, rv,
     ((typeOf(lv) IN ['Integer', 'Float'] AND typeOf(rv) IN ['Integer', 'Float'])
      OR (typeOf(lv) = 'String' AND typeOf(rv) = 'String' AND a.op = '==')) AS comparable,
     any(x IN atts WHERE x.status = 'active' AND x.on <= $now
                     AND (x.review_by IS NULL OR x.review_by >= $now)) AS attested
RETURN a.id AS id, a.check_kind AS kind, a.text AS text,
       l.id AS lhs_fact, lv, a.op AS op, r.id AS rhs_fact, rv, atts,
       CASE WHEN a.check_kind = 'manual' THEN (CASE WHEN attested THEN true ELSE null END)
            WHEN NOT comparable THEN null
            WHEN a.op = '<=' THEN lv <= rv
            WHEN a.op = '<'  THEN lv <  rv
            WHEN a.op = '>=' THEN lv >= rv
            WHEN a.op = '>'  THEN lv >  rv
            WHEN a.op = '==' THEN lv =  rv
            ELSE null END AS holds
ORDER BY id

queries.name: rollup_guarantees
queries.cypher:
// Q2a. Three valued AND over every prerequisite of each guarantee.
// $violated and $unknown hold assumption ids from E1 (unknown = unevaluable or unverified).
// broken if any reachable assumption is violated, else unknown if any is unknown, else holds.
// The witness is the shortest chain to a violated assumption if one exists, else to an unknown one.
UNWIND $guarantees AS gid
MATCH (g:Guarantee {id: gid})
OPTIONAL MATCH p = (g)-[:REQUIRES*1..6]->(a:Assumption)
WHERE a.id IN $violated OR a.id IN $unknown
WITH g, p, CASE WHEN a IS NULL THEN 2 WHEN a.id IN $violated THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS rank
ORDER BY rank, length(p)
WITH g, collect(rank) AS ranks, head(collect(p)) AS witness
RETURN g.id AS guarantee, g.statement AS statement,
       CASE WHEN 0 IN ranks THEN 'broken' WHEN 1 IN ranks THEN 'unknown' ELSE 'holds' END AS status,
       CASE WHEN witness IS NULL THEN [] ELSE [n IN nodes(witness) | n.id] END AS chain
ORDER BY guarantee

queries.name: load_bearing_guarantees
queries.cypher:
// Algorithm as a tool: guarantees required by many others score highest.
CALL algo.pageRank('Guarantee', 'REQUIRES') YIELD node, score
RETURN node.id AS guarantee, score
ORDER BY score DESC
LIMIT $limit

// Q3. Who should review a decision. Active accountable people first; if none are active,
// active current members of the teams owning the governed services, ranked by recent authored evidence.
MATCH (d:Decision {id: $decision_id})
OPTIONAL MATCH (p:Person)-[:ACCOUNTABLE_FOR]->(d)
WITH d, collect(p) AS acc
WITH d,

OPTIONAL MATCH (d)-[:GOVERNS]->(s:Service)<-[:OWNS]-(t:Team)<-[m:MEMBER_OF]-(c:Person)

queries.name: route_decision
queries.cypher:
// Q3. Who should review a decision. Active accountable people first; if none are active,
// active current members of the teams owning the governed services, ranked by recent authored evidence.
MATCH (d:Decision {id: $decision_id})
OPTIONAL MATCH (p:Person)-[:ACCOUNTABLE_FOR]->(d)
WITH d, collect(p) AS acc
WITH d,
     [x IN acc WHERE x.status = 'active' | x.id] AS active_accountable,
     [x IN acc WHERE x.status <> 'active' | x.id] AS gone
OPTIONAL MATCH (d)-[:GOVERNS]->(s:Service)<-[:OWNS]-(t:Team)<-[m:MEMBER_OF]-(c:Person)
WHERE c.status = 'active' AND m.until IS NULL
OPTIONAL MATCH (c)-[:AUTHORED]->(src:Source)<-[:PART_OF]-(:Passage)-[:MENTIONS]->(s)
WHERE src.ts >= $since
WITH d, active_accountable, gone, c, t, count(DISTINCT src) AS evidence
ORDER BY evidence DESC, c.id ASC
RETURN active_accountable, gone,
       [x IN collect({person: c.id, team: t.id, evidence: evidence}) WHERE x.person IS NOT NULL] AS candidates

queries.name: guarantee_assumption_pairs
queries.cypher:
// Every (guarantee, assumption) pair joined by a REQUIRES chain of 1 to 6 hops.
// Used upward (ancestors of touched assumptions) and downward (closure of checked guarantees).
MATCH (g:Guarantee)-[:REQUIRES*1..6]->(a:Assumption)
WHERE ($assumptions IS NULL OR a.id IN $assumptions)
  AND ($guarantees IS NULL OR g.id IN $guarantees)
RETURN DISTINCT g.id AS guarantee, a.id AS assumption
ORDER BY guarantee, assumption

queries.name: evaluate_assumptions
queries.cypher:
// E1. Evaluate assumptions under an overlay of proposed fact values.
// Predicate assumptions: compare operands; a fact present in the overlay uses the overlay value even when it is null
// (a deleted key), so missing data can never fall back to the old value.
// Manual assumptions: hold only with a current attestation by an active person; otherwise holds is null (unverified).
UNWIND $ids AS aid
MATCH (a:Assumption {id: aid})
OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[:LHS]->(l:Fact)
OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[:RHS]->(r:Fact)
OPTIONAL MATCH (p:Person)-[at:ATTESTED]->(a)
WITH a, l, r,
     [x IN collect({person: p.id, status: p.status, on: at.on, review_by: at.review_by}) WHERE x.person IS NOT NULL] AS atts
WITH a, l, r, atts,
     CASE WHEN l IS NULL THEN null
          WHEN any(o IN $overlay WHERE o.fact = l.id) THEN head([o IN $overlay WHERE o.fact = l.id | o.to])
          ELSE l.value END AS lv,
     CASE WHEN r IS NULL THEN a.rhs_const
          WHEN any(o IN $overlay WHERE o.fact = r.id) THEN head([o IN $overlay WHERE o.fact = r.id | o.to])
          ELSE r.value END AS rv
WITH a, l, r, atts, lv, rv,
     ((typeOf(lv) IN ['Integer', 'Float'] AND typeOf(rv) IN ['Integer', 'Float'])
      OR (typeOf(lv) = 'String' AND typeOf(rv) = 'String' AND a.op = '==')) AS comparable,
     any(x IN atts WHERE x.status = 'active' AND x.on <= $now
                     AND (x.review_by IS NULL OR x.review_by >= $now)) AS attested
RETURN a.id AS id, a.check_kind AS kind, a.text AS text,
       l.id AS lhs_fact, lv, a.op AS op, r.id AS rhs_fact, rv, atts,
       CASE WHEN a.check_kind = 'manual' THEN (CASE WHEN attested THEN true ELSE null END)
            WHEN NOT comparable THEN null
            WHEN a.op = '<=' THEN lv <= rv
            WHEN a.op = '<'  THEN lv <  rv
            WHEN a.op = '>=' THEN lv >= rv
            WHEN a.op = '>'  THEN lv >  rv
            WHEN a.op = '==' THEN lv =  rv
            ELSE null END AS holds
ORDER BY id

queries.name: rollup_guarantees
queries.cypher:
// Q2a. Three valued AND over every prerequisite of each guarantee.
// $violated and $unknown hold assumption ids from E1 (unknown = unevaluable or unverified).
// broken if any reachable assumption is violated, else unknown if any is unknown, else holds.
// The witness is the shortest chain to a violated assumption if one exists, else to an unknown one.
UNWIND $guarantees AS gid
MATCH (g:Guarantee {id: gid})
OPTIONAL MATCH p = (g)-[:REQUIRES*1..6]->(a:Assumption)
WHERE a.id IN $violated OR a.id IN $unknown
WITH g, p, CASE WHEN a IS NULL THEN 2 WHEN a.id IN $violated THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS rank
ORDER BY rank, length(p)
WITH g, collect(rank) AS ranks, head(collect(p)) AS witness
RETURN g.id AS guarantee, g.statement AS statement,
       CASE WHEN 0 IN ranks THEN 'broken' WHEN 1 IN ranks THEN 'unknown' ELSE 'holds' END AS status,
       CASE WHEN witness IS NULL THEN [] ELSE [n IN nodes(witness) | n.id] END AS chain
ORDER BY guarantee

queries.name: evaluate_assumptions
queries.cypher:
// E1. Evaluate assumptions under an overlay of proposed fact values.
// Predicate assumptions: compare operands; a fact present in the overlay uses the overlay value even when it is null
// (a deleted key), so missing data can never fall back to the old value.
// Manual assumptions: hold only with a current attestation by an active person; otherwise holds is null (unverified).
UNWIND $ids AS aid
MATCH (a:Assumption {id: aid})
OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[:LHS]->(l:Fact)
OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[:RHS]->(r:Fact)
OPTIONAL MATCH (p:Person)-[at:ATTESTED]->(a)
WITH a, l, r,
     [x IN collect({person: p.id, status: p.status, on: at.on, review_by: at.review_by}) WHERE x.person IS NOT NULL] AS atts
WITH a, l, r, atts,
     CASE WHEN l IS NULL THEN null
          WHEN any(o IN $overlay WHERE o.fact = l.id) THEN head([o IN $overlay WHERE o.fact = l.id | o.to])
          ELSE l.value END AS lv,
     CASE WHEN r IS NULL THEN a.rhs_const
          WHEN any(o IN $overlay WHERE o.fact = r.id) THEN head([o IN $overlay WHERE o.fact = r.id | o.to])
          ELSE r.value END AS rv
WITH a, l, r, atts, lv, rv,
     ((typeOf(lv) IN ['Integer', 'Float'] AND typeOf(rv) IN ['Integer', 'Float'])
      OR (typeOf(lv) = 'String' AND typeOf(rv) = 'String' AND a.op = '==')) AS comparable,
     any(x IN atts WHERE x.status = 'active' AND x.on <= $now
                     AND (x.review_by IS NULL OR x.review_by >= $now)) AS attested
RETURN a.id AS id, a.check_kind AS kind, a.text AS text,
       l.id AS lhs_fact, lv, a.op AS op, r.id AS rhs_fact, rv, atts,
       CASE WHEN a.check_kind = 'manual' THEN (CASE WHEN attested THEN true ELSE null END)
            WHEN NOT comparable THEN null
            WHEN a.op = '<=' THEN lv <= rv
            WHEN a.op = '<'  THEN lv <  rv
            WHEN a.op = '>=' THEN lv >= rv
            WHEN a.op = '>'  THEN lv >  rv
            WHEN a.op = '==' THEN lv =  rv
            ELSE null END AS holds
ORDER BY id

// E1. Evaluate assumptions under an overlay of proposed fact values.
// Predicate assumptions: compare operands; a fact present in the overlay uses the overlay value even when it is null

WITH a, l, r,
     [x IN collect({person: p.id, status: p.status, on: at.on, review_by: at.review_by}) WHERE x.person IS NOT NULL] AS atts
WITH a, l, r, atts,
     CASE WHEN l IS NULL THEN null
          WHEN any(o IN $overlay WHERE o.fact = l.id) THEN head([o IN $overlay WHERE o.fact = l.id | o.to])
          ELSE l.value END AS lv,
     CASE WHEN r IS NULL THEN a.rhs_const
          WHEN any(o IN $overlay WHERE o.fact = r.id) THEN head([o IN $overlay WHERE o.fact = r.id | o.to])
          ELSE r.value END AS rv
WITH a, l, r, atts, lv, rv,
     ((typeOf(lv) IN ['Integer', 'Float'] AND typeOf(rv) IN ['Integer', 'Float'])
      OR (typeOf(lv) = 'String' AND typeOf(rv) = 'String' AND a.op = '==')) AS comparable,
     any(x IN atts WHERE x.status = 'active' AND x.on <= $now
                     AND (x.review_by IS NULL OR x.review_by >= $now)) AS attested

            WHEN a.op = '>=' THEN lv >= rv

queries.name: route_decision
queries.cypher:
// Q3. Who should review a decision. Active accountable people first; if none are active,
// active current members of the teams owning the governed services, ranked by recent authored evidence.
MATCH (d:Decision {id: $decision_id})
OPTIONAL MATCH (p:Person)-[:ACCOUNTABLE_FOR]->(d)
WITH d, collect(p) AS acc
WITH d,
     [x IN acc WHERE x.status = 'active' | x.id] AS active_accountable,
     [x IN acc WHERE x.status <> 'active' | x.id] AS gone
OPTIONAL MATCH (d)-[:GOVERNS]->(s:Service)<-[:OWNS]-(t:Team)<-[m:MEMBER_OF]-(c:Person)
WHERE c.status = 'active' AND m.until IS NULL
OPTIONAL MATCH (c)-[:AUTHORED]->(src:Source)<-[:PART_OF]-(:Passage)-[:MENTIONS]->(s)
WHERE src.ts >= $since
WITH d, active_accountable, gone, c, t, count(DISTINCT src) AS evidence
ORDER BY evidence DESC, c.id ASC
RETURN active_accountable, gone,
       [x IN collect({person: c.id, team: t.id, evidence: evidence}) WHERE x.person IS NOT NULL] AS candidates

queries.name: evaluate_assumptions
queries.cypher:
// E1. Evaluate assumptions under an overlay of proposed fact values.
// Predicate assumptions: compare operands; a fact present in the overlay uses the overlay value even when it is null
// (a deleted key), so missing data can never fall back to the old value.
// Manual assumptions: hold only with a current attestation by an active person; otherwise holds is null (unverified).
UNWIND $ids AS aid
MATCH (a:Assumption {id: aid})
OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[:LHS]->(l:Fact)
OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[:RHS]->(r:Fact)
OPTIONAL MATCH (p:Person)-[at:ATTESTED]->(a)
WITH a, l, r,
     [x IN collect({person: p.id, status: p.status, on: at.on, review_by: at.review_by}) WHERE x.person IS NOT NULL] AS atts
WITH a, l, r, atts,
     CASE WHEN l IS NULL THEN null
          WHEN any(o IN $overlay WHERE o.fact = l.id) THEN head([o IN $overlay WHERE o.fact = l.id | o.to])
          ELSE l.value END AS lv,
     CASE WHEN r IS NULL THEN a.rhs_const
          WHEN any(o IN $overlay WHERE o.fact = r.id) THEN head([o IN $overlay WHERE o.fact = r.id | o.to])
          ELSE r.value END AS rv
WITH a, l, r, atts, lv, rv,
     ((typeOf(lv) IN ['Integer', 'Float'] AND typeOf(rv) IN ['Integer', 'Float'])
      OR (typeOf(lv) = 'String' AND typeOf(rv) = 'String' AND a.op = '==')) AS comparable,
     any(x IN atts WHERE x.status = 'active' AND x.on <= $now
                     AND (x.review_by IS NULL OR x.review_by >= $now)) AS attested
RETURN a.id AS id, a.check_kind AS kind, a.text AS text,
       l.id AS lhs_fact, lv, a.op AS op, r.id AS rhs_fact, rv, atts,
       CASE WHEN a.check_kind = 'manual' THEN (CASE WHEN attested THEN true ELSE null END)
            WHEN NOT comparable THEN null
            WHEN a.op = '<=' THEN lv <= rv
            WHEN a.op = '<'  THEN lv <  rv
            WHEN a.op = '>=' THEN lv >= rv
            WHEN a.op = '>'  THEN lv >  rv
            WHEN a.op = '==' THEN lv =  rv
            ELSE null END AS holds
ORDER BY id

// Q2a. Three valued AND over every prerequisite of each guarantee.
// $violated and $unknown hold assumption ids from E1 (unknown = unevaluable or unverified).
// broken if any reachable assumption is violated, else unknown if any is unknown, else holds.
// The witness is the shortest chain to a violated assumption if one exists, else to an unknown one.
UNWIND $guarantees AS gid
MATCH (g:Guarantee {id: gid})
OPTIONAL MATCH p = (g)-[:REQUIRES*1..6]->(a:Assumption)
WHERE a.id IN $violated OR a.id IN $unknown
WITH g, p, CASE WHEN a IS NULL THEN 2 WHEN a.id IN $violated THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS rank
ORDER BY rank, length(p)
WITH g, collect(rank) AS ranks, head(collect(p)) AS witness
RETURN g.id AS guarantee, g.statement AS statement,
       CASE WHEN 0 IN ranks THEN 'broken' WHEN 1 IN ranks THEN 'unknown' ELSE 'holds' END AS status,
       CASE WHEN witness IS NULL THEN [] ELSE [n IN nodes(witness) | n.id] END AS chain
ORDER BY guarantee

// Every (guarantee, assumption) pair joined by a REQUIRES chain of 1 to 6 hops.
// Used upward (ancestors of touched assumptions) and downward (closure of checked guarantees).
MATCH (g:Guarantee)-[:REQUIRES*1..6]->(a:Assumption)
WHERE ($assumptions IS NULL OR a.id IN $assumptions)
  AND ($guarantees IS NULL OR g.id IN $guarantees)
RETURN DISTINCT g.id AS guarantee, a.id AS assumption
ORDER BY guarantee, assumption

queries.name: evaluate_assumptions
queries.cypher:
// E1. Evaluate assumptions under an overlay of proposed fact values.
// Predicate assumptions: compare operands; a fact present in the overlay uses the overlay value even when it is null
// (a deleted key), so missing data can never fall back to the old value.
// Manual assumptions: hold only with a current attestation by an active person; otherwise holds is null (unverified).
UNWIND $ids AS aid
MATCH (a:Assumption {id: aid})
OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[:LHS]->(l:Fact)
OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[:RHS]->(r:Fact)
OPTIONAL MATCH (p:Person)-[at:ATTESTED]->(a)
WITH a, l, r,
     [x IN collect({person: p.id, status: p.status, on: at.on, review_by: at.review_by}) WHERE x.person IS NOT NULL] AS atts
WITH a, l, r, atts,
     CASE WHEN l IS NULL THEN null
          WHEN any(o IN $overlay WHERE o.fact = l.id) THEN head([o IN $overlay WHERE o.fact = l.id | o.to])
          ELSE l.value END AS lv,
     CASE WHEN r IS NULL THEN a.rhs_const
          WHEN any(o IN $overlay WHERE o.fact = r.id) THEN head([o IN $overlay WHERE o.fact = r.id | o.to])
          ELSE r.value END AS rv
WITH a, l, r, atts, lv, rv,
     ((typeOf(lv) IN ['Integer', 'Float'] AND typeOf(rv) IN ['Integer', 'Float'])
      OR (typeOf(lv) = 'String' AND typeOf(rv) = 'String' AND a.op = '==')) AS comparable,
     any(x IN atts WHERE x.status = 'active' AND x.on <= $now
                     AND (x.review_by IS NULL OR x.review_by >= $now)) AS attested
RETURN a.id AS id, a.check_kind AS kind, a.text AS text,
       l.id AS lhs_fact, lv, a.op AS op, r.id AS rhs_fact, rv, atts,
       CASE WHEN a.check_kind = 'manual' THEN (CASE WHEN attested THEN true ELSE null END)
            WHEN NOT comparable THEN null
            WHEN a.op = '<=' THEN lv <= rv
            WHEN a.op = '<'  THEN lv <  rv
            WHEN a.op = '>=' THEN lv >= rv
            WHEN a.op = '>'  THEN lv >  rv
            WHEN a.op = '==' THEN lv =  rv
            ELSE null END AS holds
ORDER BY id

queries.name: rollup_guarantees
queries.cypher:
// Q2a. Three valued AND over every prerequisite of each guarantee.
// $violated and $unknown hold assumption ids from E1 (unknown = unevaluable or unverified).
// broken if any reachable assumption is violated, else unknown if any is unknown, else holds.
// The witness is the shortest chain to a violated assumption if one exists, else to an unknown one.
UNWIND $guarantees AS gid
MATCH (g:Guarantee {id: gid})
OPTIONAL MATCH p = (g)-[:REQUIRES*1..6]->(a:Assumption)
WHERE a.id IN $violated OR a.id IN $unknown
WITH g, p, CASE WHEN a IS NULL THEN 2 WHEN a.id IN $violated THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS rank
ORDER BY rank, length(p)
WITH g, collect(rank) AS ranks, head(collect(p)) AS witness
RETURN g.id AS guarantee, g.statement AS statement,
       CASE WHEN 0 IN ranks THEN 'broken' WHEN 1 IN ranks THEN 'unknown' ELSE 'holds' END AS status,
       CASE WHEN witness IS NULL THEN [] ELSE [n IN nodes(witness) | n.id] END AS chain
ORDER BY guarantee

queries.name: guarantee_impact
queries.cypher:
// Q2b. For guarantees that are broken or unknown: accepted decisions that promise or rely on them,
// the services they are about, criticality tiers, and callers exposed through DEPENDS_ON (up to 3 hops).
UNWIND $guarantees AS gid
MATCH (g:Guarantee {id: gid})
OPTIONAL MATCH (pd:Decision {status: 'accepted'})-[:PROVIDES]->(g)
OPTIONAL MATCH (rd:Decision {status: 'accepted'})-[:RELIES_ON]->(g)
OPTIONAL MATCH (g)-[:ABOUT]->(s:Service)
OPTIONAL MATCH (pd)-[:GOVERNS]->(ps:Service)
OPTIONAL MATCH (rd)-[:GOVERNS]->(rs:Service)
OPTIONAL MATCH (caller:Service)-[:DEPENDS_ON*1..3]->(s)
RETURN g.id AS guarantee,
       collect(DISTINCT pd.id) AS promised_by,
       collect(DISTINCT rd.id) AS relied_on_by,
       collect(DISTINCT s.id) AS about,
       [t IN collect(DISTINCT s.tier) + collect(DISTINCT ps.tier) + collect(DISTINCT rs.tier) WHERE t IS NOT NULL] AS tiers,
       collect(DISTINCT caller.id) AS exposed_callers
ORDER BY guarantee

queries.name: route_decision
queries.cypher:
// Q3. Who should review a decision. Active accountable people first; if none are active,
// active current members of the teams owning the governed services, ranked by recent authored evidence.
MATCH (d:Decision {id: $decision_id})
OPTIONAL MATCH (p:Person)-[:ACCOUNTABLE_FOR]->(d)
WITH d, collect(p) AS acc
WITH d,
     [x IN acc WHERE x.status = 'active' | x.id] AS active_accountable,
     [x IN acc WHERE x.status <> 'active' | x.id] AS gone
OPTIONAL MATCH (d)-[:GOVERNS]->(s:Service)<-[:OWNS]-(t:Team)<-[m:MEMBER_OF]-(c:Person)
WHERE c.status = 'active' AND m.until IS NULL
OPTIONAL MATCH (c)-[:AUTHORED]->(src:Source)<-[:PART_OF]-(:Passage)-[:MENTIONS]->(s)
WHERE src.ts >= $since
WITH d, active_accountable, gone, c, t, count(DISTINCT src) AS evidence
ORDER BY evidence DESC, c.id ASC
RETURN active_accountable, gone,
       [x IN collect({person: c.id, team: t.id, evidence: evidence}) WHERE x.person IS NOT NULL] AS candidates

// Assumptions whose predicate reads at least one of the given facts.
MATCH (a:Assumption)-[:LHS|RHS]->(f:Fact)

RETURN DISTINCT a.id AS id

queries.name: siblings
queries.cypher:
// Guarantees provided by the same accepted decisions as the affected ones, but not affected themselves,
// together with the accepted decisions that rely on them. These are evaluated, not assumed healthy.
MATCH (pd:Decision {status: 'accepted'})-[:PROVIDES]->(g:Guarantee)
WHERE g.id IN $affected
MATCH (pd)-[:PROVIDES]->(sib:Guarantee)
WHERE NOT sib.id IN $affected
MATCH (rd:Decision {status: 'accepted'})-[:RELIES_ON]->(sib)
RETURN DISTINCT sib.id AS guarantee, rd.id AS decision, pd.id AS provider
ORDER BY decision, guarantee

// E1. Evaluate assumptions under an overlay of proposed fact values.
// Predicate assumptions: compare operands; a fact present in the overlay uses the overlay value even when it is null
// (a deleted key), so missing data can never fall back to the old value.
// Manual assumptions: hold only with a current attestation by an active person; otherwise holds is null (unverified).

OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[:RHS]->(r:Fact)

WITH a, l, r,
     [x IN collect({person: p.id, status: p.status, on: at.on, review_by: at.review_by}) WHERE x.person IS NOT NULL] AS atts
WITH a, l, r, atts,
     CASE WHEN l IS NULL THEN null
          WHEN any(o IN $overlay WHERE o.fact = l.id) THEN head([o IN $overlay WHERE o.fact = l.id | o.to])
          ELSE l.value END AS lv,
     CASE WHEN r IS NULL THEN a.rhs_const
          WHEN any(o IN $overlay WHERE o.fact = r.id) THEN head([o IN $overlay WHERE o.fact = r.id | o.to])
          ELSE r.value END AS rv
WITH a, l, r, atts, lv, rv,
     ((typeOf(lv) IN ['Integer', 'Float'] AND typeOf(rv) IN ['Integer', 'Float'])
      OR (typeOf(lv) = 'String' AND typeOf(rv) = 'String' AND a.op = '==')) AS comparable,
     any(x IN atts WHERE x.status = 'active' AND x.on <= $now
                     AND (x.review_by IS NULL OR x.review_by >= $now)) AS attested

       l.id AS lhs_fact, lv, a.op AS op, r.id AS rhs_fact, rv, atts,
       CASE WHEN a.check_kind = 'manual' THEN (CASE WHEN attested THEN true ELSE null END)

            WHEN a.op = '>=' THEN lv >= rv

// broken if any reachable assumption is violated, else unknown if any is unknown, else holds.
// The witness is the shortest chain to a violated assumption if one exists, else to an unknown one.
UNWIND $guarantees AS gid
MATCH (g:Guarantee {id: gid})
OPTIONAL MATCH p = (g)-[:REQUIRES*1..6]->(a:Assumption)
WHERE a.id IN $violated OR a.id IN $unknown
WITH g, p, CASE WHEN a IS NULL THEN 2 WHEN a.id IN $violated THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS rank
ORDER BY rank, length(p)
WITH g, collect(rank) AS ranks, head(collect(p)) AS witness

queries.name: evaluate_assumptions
queries.cypher:
// E1. Evaluate assumptions under an overlay of proposed fact values.
// Predicate assumptions: compare operands; a fact present in the overlay uses the overlay value even when it is null
// (a deleted key), so missing data can never fall back to the old value.
// Manual assumptions: hold only with a current attestation by an active person; otherwise holds is null (unverified).
UNWIND $ids AS aid
MATCH (a:Assumption {id: aid})
OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[:LHS]->(l:Fact)
OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[:RHS]->(r:Fact)
OPTIONAL MATCH (p:Person)-[at:ATTESTED]->(a)
WITH a, l, r,
     [x IN collect({person: p.id, status: p.status, on: at.on, review_by: at.review_by}) WHERE x.person IS NOT NULL] AS atts
WITH a, l, r, atts,
     CASE WHEN l IS NULL THEN null
          WHEN any(o IN $overlay WHERE o.fact = l.id) THEN head([o IN $overlay WHERE o.fact = l.id | o.to])
          ELSE l.value END AS lv,
     CASE WHEN r IS NULL THEN a.rhs_const
          WHEN any(o IN $overlay WHERE o.fact = r.id) THEN head([o IN $overlay WHERE o.fact = r.id | o.to])
          ELSE r.value END AS rv
WITH a, l, r, atts, lv, rv,
     ((typeOf(lv) IN ['Integer', 'Float'] AND typeOf(rv) IN ['Integer', 'Float'])
      OR (typeOf(lv) = 'String' AND typeOf(rv) = 'String' AND a.op = '==')) AS comparable,
     any(x IN atts WHERE x.status = 'active' AND x.on <= $now
                     AND (x.review_by IS NULL OR x.review_by >= $now)) AS attested
RETURN a.id AS id, a.check_kind AS kind, a.text AS text,
       l.id AS lhs_fact, lv, a.op AS op, r.id AS rhs_fact, rv, atts,
       CASE WHEN a.check_kind = 'manual' THEN (CASE WHEN attested THEN true ELSE null END)
            WHEN NOT comparable THEN null
            WHEN a.op = '<=' THEN lv <= rv
            WHEN a.op = '<'  THEN lv <  rv
            WHEN a.op = '>=' THEN lv >= rv
            WHEN a.op = '>'  THEN lv >  rv
            WHEN a.op = '==' THEN lv =  rv
            ELSE null END AS holds
ORDER BY id

queries.name: guarantee_impact
queries.cypher:
// Q2b. For guarantees that are broken or unknown: accepted decisions that promise or rely on them,
// the services they are about, criticality tiers, and callers exposed through DEPENDS_ON (up to 3 hops).
UNWIND $guarantees AS gid
MATCH (g:Guarantee {id: gid})
OPTIONAL MATCH (pd:Decision {status: 'accepted'})-[:PROVIDES]->(g)
OPTIONAL MATCH (rd:Decision {status: 'accepted'})-[:RELIES_ON]->(g)
OPTIONAL MATCH (g)-[:ABOUT]->(s:Service)
OPTIONAL MATCH (pd)-[:GOVERNS]->(ps:Service)
OPTIONAL MATCH (rd)-[:GOVERNS]->(rs:Service)
OPTIONAL MATCH (caller:Service)-[:DEPENDS_ON*1..3]->(s)

       collect(DISTINCT pd.id) AS promised_by,
       collect(DISTINCT rd.id) AS relied_on_by,
       collect(DISTINCT s.id) AS about,
       [t IN collect(DISTINCT s.tier) + collect(DISTINCT ps.tier) + collect(DISTINCT rs.tier) WHERE t IS NOT NULL] AS tiers,
       collect(DISTINCT caller.id) AS exposed_callers
ORDER BY guarantee

// Q3. Who should review a decision. Active accountable people first; if none are active,

MATCH (d:Decision {id: $decision_id})

WITH d, collect(p) AS acc
WITH d,

       [x IN collect({person: c.id, team: t.id, evidence: evidence}) WHERE x.person IS NOT NULL] AS candidates

queries.name: route_decision
queries.cypher:
// Q3. Who should review a decision. Active accountable people first; if none are active,
// active current members of the teams owning the governed services, ranked by recent authored evidence.
MATCH (d:Decision {id: $decision_id})
OPTIONAL MATCH (p:Person)-[:ACCOUNTABLE_FOR]->(d)
WITH d, collect(p) AS acc
WITH d,
     [x IN acc WHERE x.status = 'active' | x.id] AS active_accountable,
     [x IN acc WHERE x.status <> 'active' | x.id] AS gone
OPTIONAL MATCH (d)-[:GOVERNS]->(s:Service)<-[:OWNS]-(t:Team)<-[m:MEMBER_OF]-(c:Person)
WHERE c.status = 'active' AND m.until IS NULL
OPTIONAL MATCH (c)-[:AUTHORED]->(src:Source)<-[:PART_OF]-(:Passage)-[:MENTIONS]->(s)
WHERE src.ts >= $since
WITH d, active_accountable, gone, c, t, count(DISTINCT src) AS evidence
ORDER BY evidence DESC, c.id ASC
RETURN active_accountable, gone,
       [x IN collect({person: c.id, team: t.id, evidence: evidence}) WHERE x.person IS NOT NULL] AS candidates

queries.name: guarantee_assumption_pairs
queries.cypher:
// Every (guarantee, assumption) pair joined by a REQUIRES chain of 1 to 6 hops.
// Used upward (ancestors of touched assumptions) and downward (closure of checked guarantees).
MATCH (g:Guarantee)-[:REQUIRES*1..6]->(a:Assumption)
WHERE ($assumptions IS NULL OR a.id IN $assumptions)
  AND ($guarantees IS NULL OR g.id IN $guarantees)
RETURN DISTINCT g.id AS guarantee, a.id AS assumption
ORDER BY guarantee, assumption

queries.name: evaluate_assumptions
queries.cypher:
// E1. Evaluate assumptions under an overlay of proposed fact values.
// Predicate assumptions: compare operands; a fact present in the overlay uses the overlay value even when it is null
// (a deleted key), so missing data can never fall back to the old value.
// Manual assumptions: hold only with a current attestation by an active person; otherwise holds is null (unverified).
UNWIND $ids AS aid
MATCH (a:Assumption {id: aid})
OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[:LHS]->(l:Fact)
OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[:RHS]->(r:Fact)
OPTIONAL MATCH (p:Person)-[at:ATTESTED]->(a)
WITH a, l, r,
     [x IN collect({person: p.id, status: p.status, on: at.on, review_by: at.review_by}) WHERE x.person IS NOT NULL] AS atts
WITH a, l, r, atts,
     CASE WHEN l IS NULL THEN null
          WHEN any(o IN $overlay WHERE o.fact = l.id) THEN head([o IN $overlay WHERE o.fact = l.id | o.to])
          ELSE l.value END AS lv,
     CASE WHEN r IS NULL THEN a.rhs_const
          WHEN any(o IN $overlay WHERE o.fact = r.id) THEN head([o IN $overlay WHERE o.fact = r.id | o.to])
          ELSE r.value END AS rv
WITH a, l, r, atts, lv, rv,
     ((typeOf(lv) IN ['Integer', 'Float'] AND typeOf(rv) IN ['Integer', 'Float'])
      OR (typeOf(lv) = 'String' AND typeOf(rv) = 'String' AND a.op = '==')) AS comparable,
     any(x IN atts WHERE x.status = 'active' AND x.on <= $now
                     AND (x.review_by IS NULL OR x.review_by >= $now)) AS attested
RETURN a.id AS id, a.check_kind AS kind, a.text AS text,
       l.id AS lhs_fact, lv, a.op AS op, r.id AS rhs_fact, rv, atts,
       CASE WHEN a.check_kind = 'manual' THEN (CASE WHEN attested THEN true ELSE null END)
            WHEN NOT comparable THEN null
            WHEN a.op = '<=' THEN lv <= rv
            WHEN a.op = '<'  THEN lv <  rv
            WHEN a.op = '>=' THEN lv >= rv
            WHEN a.op = '>'  THEN lv >  rv
            WHEN a.op = '==' THEN lv =  rv
            ELSE null END AS holds
ORDER BY id

queries.name: rollup_guarantees
queries.cypher:
// Q2a. Three valued AND over every prerequisite of each guarantee.
// $violated and $unknown hold assumption ids from E1 (unknown = unevaluable or unverified).
// broken if any reachable assumption is violated, else unknown if any is unknown, else holds.
// The witness is the shortest chain to a violated assumption if one exists, else to an unknown one.
UNWIND $guarantees AS gid
MATCH (g:Guarantee {id: gid})
OPTIONAL MATCH p = (g)-[:REQUIRES*1..6]->(a:Assumption)
WHERE a.id IN $violated OR a.id IN $unknown
WITH g, p, CASE WHEN a IS NULL THEN 2 WHEN a.id IN $violated THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS rank
ORDER BY rank, length(p)
WITH g, collect(rank) AS ranks, head(collect(p)) AS witness
RETURN g.id AS guarantee, g.statement AS statement,
       CASE WHEN 0 IN ranks THEN 'broken' WHEN 1 IN ranks THEN 'unknown' ELSE 'holds' END AS status,
       CASE WHEN witness IS NULL THEN [] ELSE [n IN nodes(witness) | n.id] END AS chain
ORDER BY guarantee

queries.name: load_bearing_guarantees
queries.cypher:
// Algorithm as a tool: guarantees required by many others score highest.
CALL algo.pageRank('Guarantee', 'REQUIRES') YIELD node, score
RETURN node.id AS guarantee, score
ORDER BY score DESC
LIMIT $limit

queries.cypher:
// Q3. Who should review a decision. Active accountable people first; if none are active,
// active current members of the teams owning the governed services, ranked by recent authored evidence.
MATCH (d:Decision {id: $decision_id})
OPTIONAL MATCH (p:Person)-[:ACCOUNTABLE_FOR]->(d)
WITH d, collect(p) AS acc
WITH d,
     [x IN acc WHERE x.status = 'active' | x.id] AS active_accountable,
     [x IN acc WHERE x.status <> 'active' | x.id] AS gone
OPTIONAL MATCH (d)-[:GOVERNS]->(s:Service)<-[:OWNS]-(t:Team)<-[m:MEMBER_OF]-(c:Person)
WHERE c.status = 'active' AND m.until IS NULL
OPTIONAL MATCH (c)-[:AUTHORED]->(src:Source)<-[:PART_OF]-(:Passage)-[:MENTIONS]->(s)
WHERE src.ts >= $since
WITH d, active_accountable, gone, c, t, count(DISTINCT src) AS evidence
ORDER BY evidence DESC, c.id ASC
RETURN active_accountable, gone,
       [x IN collect({person: c.id, team: t.id, evidence: evidence}) WHERE x.person IS NOT NULL] AS candidates

queries.name: guarantee_assumption_pairs
queries.cypher:
// Every (guarantee, assumption) pair joined by a REQUIRES chain of 1 to 6 hops.
// Used upward (ancestors of touched assumptions) and downward (closure of checked guarantees).
MATCH (g:Guarantee)-[:REQUIRES*1..6]->(a:Assumption)
WHERE ($assumptions IS NULL OR a.id IN $assumptions)
  AND ($guarantees IS NULL OR g.id IN $guarantees)
RETURN DISTINCT g.id AS guarantee, a.id AS assumption
ORDER BY guarantee, assumption

queries.name: evaluate_assumptions
queries.cypher:
// E1. Evaluate assumptions under an overlay of proposed fact values.
// Predicate assumptions: compare operands; a fact present in the overlay uses the overlay value even when it is null
// (a deleted key), so missing data can never fall back to the old value.
// Manual assumptions: hold only with a current attestation by an active person; otherwise holds is null (unverified).
UNWIND $ids AS aid
MATCH (a:Assumption {id: aid})
OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[:LHS]->(l:Fact)
OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[:RHS]->(r:Fact)
OPTIONAL MATCH (p:Person)-[at:ATTESTED]->(a)
WITH a, l, r,
     [x IN collect({person: p.id, status: p.status, on: at.on, review_by: at.review_by}) WHERE x.person IS NOT NULL] AS atts
WITH a, l, r, atts,
     CASE WHEN l IS NULL THEN null
          WHEN any(o IN $overlay WHERE o.fact = l.id) THEN head([o IN $overlay WHERE o.fact = l.id | o.to])
          ELSE l.value END AS lv,
     CASE WHEN r IS NULL THEN a.rhs_const
          WHEN any(o IN $overlay WHERE o.fact = r.id) THEN head([o IN $overlay WHERE o.fact = r.id | o.to])
          ELSE r.value END AS rv
WITH a, l, r, atts, lv, rv,
     ((typeOf(lv) IN ['Integer', 'Float'] AND typeOf(rv) IN ['Integer', 'Float'])
      OR (typeOf(lv) = 'String' AND typeOf(rv) = 'String' AND a.op = '==')) AS comparable,
     any(x IN atts WHERE x.status = 'active' AND x.on <= $now
                     AND (x.review_by IS NULL OR x.review_by >= $now)) AS attested
RETURN a.id AS id, a.check_kind AS kind, a.text AS text,
       l.id AS lhs_fact, lv, a.op AS op, r.id AS rhs_fact, rv, atts,
       CASE WHEN a.check_kind = 'manual' THEN (CASE WHEN attested THEN true ELSE null END)
            WHEN NOT comparable THEN null
            WHEN a.op = '<=' THEN lv <= rv
            WHEN a.op = '<'  THEN lv <  rv
            WHEN a.op = '>=' THEN lv >= rv
            WHEN a.op = '>'  THEN lv >  rv
            WHEN a.op = '==' THEN lv =  rv
            ELSE null END AS holds
ORDER BY id

queries.name: rollup_guarantees
queries.cypher:
// Q2a. Three valued AND over every prerequisite of each guarantee.
// $violated and $unknown hold assumption ids from E1 (unknown = unevaluable or unverified).
// broken if any reachable assumption is violated, else unknown if any is unknown, else holds.
// The witness is the shortest chain to a violated assumption if one exists, else to an unknown one.
UNWIND $guarantees AS gid
MATCH (g:Guarantee {id: gid})
OPTIONAL MATCH p = (g)-[:REQUIRES*1..6]->(a:Assumption)
WHERE a.id IN $violated OR a.id IN $unknown
WITH g, p, CASE WHEN a IS NULL THEN 2 WHEN a.id IN $violated THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS rank
ORDER BY rank, length(p)
WITH g, collect(rank) AS ranks, head(collect(p)) AS witness
RETURN g.id AS guarantee, g.statement AS statement,
       CASE WHEN 0 IN ranks THEN 'broken' WHEN 1 IN ranks THEN 'unknown' ELSE 'holds' END AS status,
       CASE WHEN witness IS NULL THEN [] ELSE [n IN nodes(witness) | n.id] END AS chain
ORDER BY guarantee

queries.name: load_bearing_guarantees
queries.cypher:
// Algorithm as a tool: guarantees required by many others score highest.
CALL algo.pageRank('Guarantee', 'REQUIRES') YIELD node, score
RETURN node.id AS guarantee, score
ORDER BY score DESC
LIMIT $limit
